```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(brms)
library(SBC)
source(here::here("00_R", "simulate_shots_3.R"))
```

First we generate 1,000 synthetic observations using our simulate_l2m function

```{r}
seed <- 123

synthetic_data <- simulate_shots(n_observations = 100, n_defenders = 50, n_teams = 5, seed = seed)
```

We'll define our model using brms syntax:

```{r}
# Define the model formula
foul_binomial_formula_varying_slopes_mo <- bf(
  shots_made | trials(shots_taken) ~ 
    1 + mo(defender_foul_count) +
    (1 + mo(defender_foul_count) | shot_movement) +
    (1 + mo(defender_foul_count) | shot_distance_category) +
    (1 + mo(defender_foul_count) | position) +
    (1 + mo(defender_foul_count) | defender_id) +
    (1 + mo(defender_foul_count) | defensive_team_id) +
    (1 | offensive_team_id) 
)

# default brms priors
foul_priors_1 <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = "b"),  # Fixed effects
  prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = "sd"),  # Random effect standard deviations
  prior(lkj(2), class = "cor")  # Random effect correlations
)

foul_priors_2 <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b"),  # Fixed effects
  # Random effects using exponential prior for SD
  prior(exponential(1), class = "sd"),
  prior(lkj(2), class = "cor")
)

foul_priors_3 <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "Intercept"),  # Fixed effects, weakly regularizing
  prior(normal(0.2, 0.5), class = "b", coef = "modefender_foul_count"), # Likely positive effect, likely small
  prior(exponential(1), class = "sd"),
  prior(dirichlet(c(1, 1, 1, 1.5, 1.5)), class = "simo", coef = "modefender_foul_count1"),
  prior(lkj(2), class = "cor")
)

```

```{r}
# Create synthetic dataframe for modeling
synthetic_df <- synthetic_data
```

```{r}
# Perform prior predictive checks
prior_check_model_default <- brm(
  formula = foul_binomial_formula_varying_slopes_mo,
  data = synthetic_df,
  family = binomial(link = "logit"),
  prior = default_priors,
  sample_prior = "only",  # Only sample from priors
  chains = 2,
  cores = 2,
  iter = 1000,
  warmup = 500,
  seed = 42,
  backend = "cmdstanr"
)
```

```{r}
# Function to generate prior predictive check plots
generate_prior_check_plots <- function(model, model_name) {
  # Generate predictions
  prior_predictions <- posterior_predict(model)
  prior_means <- colMeans(prior_predictions)
  
  # Create a data frame for plotting
  prior_plot_data <- data.frame(
    observed = synthetic_df$shots_defended_made,
    predicted = prior_means,
    position = synthetic_df$defender_position
  )
  
  # Plot prior predictions vs observed
  p1 <- ggplot(prior_plot_data, aes(x = observed, y = predicted, color = position)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
    labs(title = paste("Prior Predictive Check -", model_name),
         x = "Observed Shots Made",
         y = "Predicted Shots Made") +
    theme_minimal()
  
  # Extract prior draws
  prior_draws <- as_draws_df(model)
  
  # Get fixed effect column name
  b_cols <- grep("^b_mo", colnames(prior_draws), value = TRUE)
  if (length(b_cols) > 0) {
    b_col <- b_cols[1]
  } else {
    b_col <- "b_Intercept" # Fallback
  }
  
  # Plot prior distributions for fixed effects
  p2 <- ggplot(prior_draws, aes_string(x = b_col)) +
    geom_density(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.5) +
    labs(title = paste("Prior Distribution:", model_name),
         x = "Effect Size",
         y = "Density") +
    theme_minimal()
  
  # Plot prior distributions for random effect standard deviations
  sd_cols <- grep("^sd_", colnames(prior_draws), value = TRUE)
  if (length(sd_cols) > 0) {
    sd_col <- sd_cols[1]
    
    p3 <- ggplot(prior_draws, aes_string(x = sd_col)) +
      geom_density(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.5) +
      labs(title = paste("Random Effect SD:", model_name),
           x = "Standard Deviation",
           y = "Density") +
      theme_minimal()
    
    return(list(p1 = p1, p2 = p2, p3 = p3))
  }
  
  return(list(p1 = p1, p2 = p2))
}
```

```{r}
# Generate plots for each model
plots_default <- generate_prior_check_plots(prior_check_model_default, "Default Priors")
plots_1 <- generate_prior_check_plots(prior_check_model_1, "Prior Set 1")
plots_2 <- generate_prior_check_plots(prior_check_model_2, "Prior Set 2")
plots_3 <- generate_prior_check_plots(prior_check_model_3, "Prior Set 3")

# Display plots comparing predicted vs observed
library(patchwork)
plots_default$p1 + plots_1$p1 + plots_2$p1 + plots_3$p1 + 
  plot_layout(ncol = 2) + 
  plot_annotation(title = "Comparison of Prior Predictive Checks across Models")

# Display plots comparing fixed effects
plots_default$p2 + plots_1$p2 + plots_2$p2 + plots_3$p2 + 
  plot_layout(ncol = 2) + 
  plot_annotation(title = "Comparison of Fixed Effects Priors")

# Display plots comparing random effects SDs
plots_default$p3 + plots_1$p3 + plots_2$p3 + plots_3$p3 + 
  plot_layout(ncol = 2) + 
  plot_annotation(title = "Comparison of Random Effects SD Priors")
```

```{r}
# Compare posterior predictive checks
pp_check_plots <- list(
  pp_default = pp_check(prior_check_model_default, type = "dens_overlay", ndraws = 50),
  pp_1 = pp_check(prior_check_model_1, type = "dens_overlay", ndraws = 50),
  pp_2 = pp_check(prior_check_model_2, type = "dens_overlay", ndraws = 50),
  pp_3 = pp_check(prior_check_model_3, type = "dens_overlay", ndraws = 50)
)

# Display posterior predictive check plots
pp_check_plots$pp_default + pp_check_plots$pp_1 + pp_check_plots$pp_2 + pp_check_plots$pp_3 + 
  plot_layout(ncol = 2) + 
  plot_annotation(title = "Comparison of Posterior Predictive Checks")
```

```{r}
# Compare the range of predicted values from each model
predict_range <- function(model, model_name) {
  preds <- posterior_predict(model)
  pred_means <- colMeans(preds)
  data.frame(
    model = model_name,
    min_pred = min(pred_means),
    mean_pred = mean(pred_means),
    median_pred = median(pred_means),
    max_pred = max(pred_means)
  )
}

pred_ranges <- rbind(
  predict_range(prior_check_model_default, "Default"),
  predict_range(prior_check_model_1, "Prior 1"),
  predict_range(prior_check_model_2, "Prior 2"),
  predict_range(prior_check_model_3, "Prior 3")
)

pred_ranges

# Visualize the range of predictions
ggplot(pred_ranges, aes(x = model, y = mean_pred)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = min_pred, ymax = max_pred), width = 0.2) +
  labs(title = "Range of Predicted Values by Prior",
       x = "Prior Set",
       y = "Predicted Value") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
options(mc.cores = parallel::detectCores())

# Enabling parallel processing via future
library(future)
plan(multisession)

options(SBC.min_chunk_size = 5)

generator <- SBC_generator_brms(formula = foul_binomial_formula_varying_slopes_mo, family = binomial(link = "logit"), data = synthetic_df, prior = foul_priors_3, backend = "cmdstanr", 
                                thin = 50, warmup = 10000, refresh = 2000,
                                out_stan_file = file.path("05-1_models/brms_generator_varying_slopes_mo_2.stan")
                                )

set.seed(seed)

datasets <- generate_datasets(generator, 100)

prior_sd <- calculate_prior_sd(datasets)

backend <- SBC_backend_brms_from_generator(generator, chains = 1, thin = 1,
                            warmup = 500, iter = 1500,               
                            inits = 0.1)

results_100 <- compute_SBC(datasets, backend,
                    cache_mode = "results", 
                    cache_location = "results_vs-mo_100")

plot_rank_hist(results_1000)

plot_ecdf_diff(results_1000)

hist(results_1000$stats$rhat)

hist(results_1000$stats$ess_bulk)

hist(results_1000$stats$z_score)

z_score_results_1000 <- results_1000$stats$z_score

contraction_result_1000 <- 1 - (results_1000$stats$sd / prior_sd)**2


plot(results_1000, z_score_results_1000, col=c("#8F272720"), lwd=2, pch=16, cex=0.8,
     xlim=c(0, 1), xlab="Posterior Contraction",
     ylim=c(-5, 5), ylab="Posterior z-Score")



```
